messages.en: The music show is overrr!

messages.ko: 난 역시나 캐나다 미국 시차와 잘맞아
messages.en: As expected, the time difference in Canada and the US really suits me.
Maybe it's because I was always awake until the early hours in Korea,
but I always have such a productive, healthy routine here.
I'm on my way to the hotel now.
I think I look pretty today.
My first performance with dark hair.
Of course I had Pepero~~

messages.ko: 심지어 오늘 빼빼로 엄청준비해주셔서 하나씩 가져갔어
messages.en: They even prepared tons of Pepero for us today, so we each got to take some.
I'm touched.
Today,
I managed to get a few good selfies.
I'll post them in Cosmo Room.
A little later.
I'll go into my room
and come back.
Wait for me~
I'm back!
What time is it in Korea?
1 o'clock.
That's a pretty good time.
I think
I'm so hungry. I feel like I need to eat something ㅠ
My roommate is a magical fish.
Oh, it's Chaewon ㅋㅋㅋ
That's right.
So, today,
I woke up after sleeping,
and Kim Chaewon was sleeping right there in my bed with me.
She was cold, so she'd been using me as a human hot pack.
I didn't even notice because I was sleeping so soundly..

messages.ko: 나 근데 진짜 행복한 꿈을 꿨어
messages.en: But I had a really happy dream.
I was on tour,
and the scenery outside was absolutely beautiful.
It was so beautiful, like something straight out of Aladdin.
So I started singing and dancing
and everything,
but it turned out the whole thing had been filmed.
All the writers and producers were there.
Then suddenly, they said they were going to release it as a fancam.
So I watched it when it came out,
and I looked prettier than I ever had.
The background was gorgeous, too.
The members and all the WAVs came over, too,

messages.ko: 그 직캠 엄청 큰 티비로 다같이 보는데
messages.en: and we all watched the fancam together on this huge TV.

messages.ko: 옆에서 불꽃놀이 터지고 다같이 환호성을 막 하는데
messages.en: Fireworks were going off beside us, and everyone was cheering.
Kim Chaewon was standing next to me,
and she was like,
Hey, pretty nice, huh? ㅋㅋ
So I said,
'Hey, I'm genuinely so happy right now.'
And the moment I said that, I woke up.
And when I woke up, she was lying right next to me.
I told her the whole dream as soon as I woke up.
I can't get over the version of myself I saw in that dream.
I remember my dreams really well.

messages.ko: 아예 꿈을 안꾸거나 꿈을 생생하게 꾸거나
messages.en: Either I don't dream at all, or my dreams are incredibly vivid.
That's how it is with me.

messages.ko: 나 최근에 꾼 꿈 중에 젤 행복했던거 하연이 나오는 꿈이었는데
messages.en: The happiest dream I've had recently was one where Hayeon appeared.
Ooh, that's exciting.
Y/N was in my dream today, too.
How come you never show up in my dreams, Hayeon?
I'm too busy.
I'm always flying around from place to place,
my wings have gotten all worn out.
I guess I need to fix your wings…
Fix them for me.
Give me wings like a MapleStory character someone has spent a ton of money on.
I miss you so much I could die.
Would you believe me if I told you I was already dead?
Oh, right! We filmed that PC bang episode recently.
Valorant really is so hard, though.
I was definitely shooting,
but none of my shots would land.
The queen of Overwatch, but a troll in Valorant?
That's the kind of alternate universe we're talking about.
You jump way too much ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㄹㅋㄴㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
I thought jumping and moving around were just the defaultㅠㅍㅍ
In Valorant, you have to stand still when you shoot.
Well, that's news to me.
Can I at least jump with my hands?
Sorry.
That joke was so lame.
Then what does that make me, since I laughed?
Someone with a sophisticated sense of humor.
But there's one thing I'm proud of.
This is my third tour, after all.
I can finally act a little like a tour veteran.
When the members bring something up,
I can go, 'Ah~ that~? This is how it was on the last tour~'
'Back in my day~~'
Actually, now that I think about it, maybe it's not veteran energy,
but old-fogey energy.
I really think I'm turning into a nagging old-timer.
I can just tell.
Whenever there's something I know,
I want to show off a little~
and go around telling everyone about it.
I can't believe myself.
I'll try to rein myself in.
Aren't you just a thoughtful person?
You always know how to say things so nicely.
Is it very different from when eight of you came?
Yeah, it's a little different.
When there were eight of us,
it really felt like we were on tour.
We also had plenty of time to explore and enjoy the places we visited,
so I really felt like, 'Wow, I've actually come all the way to the Americas.'
That's what it felt like.

messages.ko: 지금은 뭔가 한국의 이국적인 지역에 와있나..?
messages.en: But now it feels like I've just come to some exotic part of Korea..?
I've completely lost my sense of reality.
Didn't you say you've only been eating Korean food?
That's right ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋ
Since we got here, we've had budae-jjigae, galbi, spicy pork, and dak-bokkeum-tang.
Now that I think about it, we've eaten nothing but Korean food.
I heard the turbulence was pretty bad. Weren't you scared, Hayeon?
How did you know??

messages.ko: 난 이렇게 가는구나 싶었어 진짜 ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋ
messages.en: I genuinely thought, 'So this is how it ends for me...' ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋ
The plane was like a roller coaster.
I kept feeling weightless.
I even started imagining what might happen.
What if we went down right here…..
What position would give me the best chance of surviving?
Should I send a message to my family first?
Those were the kinds of thoughts I was having.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 근데 추락하면 살아남을 수가 잇어? 바다로 떨어지면 살 수 잇으려나
messages.en: But could you even survive a crash? I wonder if you'd have a chance if the plane fell into the ocean.
I'd smash the window and just dive out on my own.
Shion unnie was sitting next to me,
and I was so scared that I grabbed her hand really tight and wouldn't let go.
My hands kept getting sweaty, too.
I even wondered what my last words to her would be if we crashed.
You really had every possible scenario planned out.
Exactly.
I make up all kinds of scenarios in my head even when nothing is happening.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Y/N would be really sad, wouldn't they??
I was thinking about all sorts of things,
but as soon as the turbulence stopped, I fell asleep so hard that I didn't even realize we'd arrived.
But here's the funny thing about me.
Even when I'm sleeping so deeply that someone could carry me off and I wouldn't notice,
the moment the in-flight meal arrives next to me,

messages.ko: 안잤던 사람처럼 벌떡 일어나서 책상 핌
messages.en: I spring right up, unfold my tray table, and act like I was never asleep.

messages.ko: 린언니가 내가 갑자기 일어나서 밥먹을 준비하길래
messages.en: Lynn unnie said that when she saw me suddenly sit up and get ready to eat,
she thought, 'Wow, this girl is something else' ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
But it's not like I do it on purpose.
It's instinct.
I'm just so curious about what it'll taste like ㅠㅠ
Would you feel so upset if you slept through the meal and missed it?
When I see that sticker stuck on the seat in front of me,
I feel so cheated.

messages.ko: 아 그리구 오늘 토론토 공연 했는데
messages.en: Oh, and we had our concert in Toronto today.
I got to feel that special tour energy again after such a long time,
and I got so much of it from everyone.
It made me so happy.
Seeing all the WAVs cheering with so much energy
really gives me a boost.
We ordered pho.
I'm going to eat and then go to sleep.
Let's do our best tomorrow, too!
And good luck to all of you who are going about your day!
I'm going to go wash up now.
I miss you~~
Haranghae 😃❤️
